text: Breach by underwriters will in general happen only after a dramatic shift in the DAO's future prospects, such as a sharp decrease in expected future revenues or a sharp increase in expected payments on outstanding policies.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
abstract: In general, this will happen only if there is a dramatic shift in the future prospects of the DAO, such as a sharp decrease in expected future revenues or a sharp increase in expected payments on outstanding policies.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: dramatic shift in the DAO's future prospects
